notes: All samples grown at 42 °C from dilution (5000-fold into ABTG-CAA at 42 °C), so treatment heat with exposure adapted for every sample per the settled rule; WT/pACYC (empty vector) is still the study's reference condition and is marked is_control true. ABTG-CAA read as a salts-based medium with casamino acids (minimal_plus_hydrolysate, amino acids supplied); carbon source not spelled out, left empty. No inducer is described for pdsrA, so inducer_added false as study default. Each sample is a pool of three biological replicates.

growth_temperature.q: were grown to mid-log phase (OD450=0.15~0.2) at 42 °C with shaking

growth_phase.q: were grown to mid-log phase (OD450=0.15~0.2) at 42 °C with shaking

treatment.q: were diluted 5000-fold into fresh ABTG-CAA medium and were grown to mid-log phase (OD450=0.15~0.2) at 42 °C

exposure.q: were diluted 5000-fold into fresh ABTG-CAA medium and were grown to mid-log phase (OD450=0.15~0.2) at 42 °C

inducer_added.q: Overnight cultures (LB medium) of WT/pACYC，WT/pdsrA，Δdps/pACYC and Δdps/pdsrA strains were diluted 5000-fold

transcription_arrested.q: Overnight cultures (LB medium) of WT/pACYC，WT/pdsrA，Δdps/pACYC and Δdps/pdsrA strains were diluted 5000-fold

mixed_organism.q: Overnight cultures (LB medium) of WT/pACYC，WT/pdsrA，Δdps/pACYC and Δdps/pdsrA strains were diluted 5000-fold

assay_class.q: Cells were harvested for total RNA extraction and subsequent RNA-seq.

rrna_removal.q: the rRNA was depleted from 1 microgram of total RNA using illumina MRZB12424 Ribo-Zero rRNA Removal Kit (Bacteria)
